checks.name: duplicate_transactions
checks.description: Same card, timestamp, amount and merchant under a different transaccion_id (extra copies only).

checks.name: negative_amount_not_reversal
checks.description: Negative amount on an approved/declined row (only reversals may be negative).

checks.name: category_domain
checks.description: Merchant category outside the 8 allowed values.

checks.name: client_card_mismatch
checks.description: Transaction's cliente_id differs from the owner of its card.

checks.name: currency_domain
checks.description: Currency outside the allowed domain (MXN, COP, BRL, USD).

checks.name: null_key_fields
checks.description: NULL in a mandatory column (tarjeta_id, cliente_id, fecha_hora, monto, moneda, categoria_comercio, estatus).

checks.name: orphan_card_client
checks.description: Card whose cliente_id does not exist in clientes.

checks.name: orphan_transaction_card
checks.description: Transaction whose tarjeta_id does not exist in tarjetas.

checks.name: orphan_transaction_client
checks.description: Transaction whose cliente_id does not exist in clientes.

checks.name: status_domain
checks.description: Status outside the allowed domain (aprobada, rechazada, reversada).

checks.name: zero_amount
checks.description: Amount equal to zero (meaningless for a card payment).

checks.name: null_merchant
checks.description: Merchant name (comercio) is NULL: the row cannot be attributed or deduplicated.

checks.name: currency_country_mismatch
checks.description: Currency is neither USD nor the local currency of the client's country.

checks.name: reversal_positive_amount
checks.description: Reversal recorded with a positive amount (would double-count spend).

checks.name: transaction_before_card_issue
checks.description: Transaction dated before the card's issue date.

checks.name: transaction_before_client_signup
checks.description: Transaction dated before the client's signup date.

checks.name: cards_without_transactions
checks.description: Issued cards with no transaction at all (activation gap, not an error).

checks.name: clients_without_approved_transactions
checks.description: Clients that never completed an approved transaction.
